justification: Direct array indexing without bounds validation of user-provided register index
analysis: This function takes a register index 'dreg' from user input and uses it to directly index into the 'track->regs' array without any bounds checking. An attacker could provide an invalid dreg value that exceeds the array bounds, leading to memory corruption when writing to track->regs[dreg]. The function performs direct memory writes to the array elements but does not validate the register index against the array size.
